name: @radarclip/controls
description: Playback controls for a radarclip player: <radarclip-controls for="player-id">

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --external:@radarclip/player --outfile=dist/radarclip-controls.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=RadarclipControls --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/radarclip-controls.iife.js
